title: PandaX-4T Dark Matter WIMPs Are Probably Bound States of Dirac Magnetic Monopoles
content: The PandaX Collaboration reported on an excess of 4.3 events above the background in the PandaX-4T experiment. The best fit for this excess was obtained for a WIMP mass of 6 GeV. Here I show that both the mass and the interaction cross-section are compatible with bound states of Dirac magnetic monopoles.
